commands.command: 'Get-Content inputs/TASK.md; Get-ChildItem -Force; if (Test-Path .agents/skills) { Get-ChildItem .agents/skills -Recurse -Filter SKILL.md | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName }'

"Get-Content .agents/skills/bio-thesis-formatter/scripts/docx_package.py; Get-Content .agents/skills/bio-thesis-formatter/scripts/init_thesis_docx.py | Select-Object -Skip 585 -First 32; python -B -c \"import zipfile,pathlib; [(print('\\nFILE',p.name),[(print(n,z.read(n).decode('utf-8'))) for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.xml')]) for p in pathlib.Path('inputs').glob('*.*') if p.suffix in ('.docx','.dotx') for z in [zipfile.ZipFile(p)]]\""

"@'
import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, hashlib, zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
inputs = root / 'inputs'
before = {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in inputs.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
rows = json.loads((inputs / 'intake.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
script = root / '.agents/skills/bio-thesis-formatter/scripts/bio_thesis.py'
for row in rows:
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(script), 'init', '--template', str(inputs / row['template']), '--output', str(root / 'output' / row['output']), '--review-stage', 'blind', '--title-en', row['title_en'], '--major', row['major'], '--author', row['author'], '--student-id', row['student_id']], check=True)
W = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}'
CT = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types}'
identifiers = [r[k] for r in rows for k in ('author','student_id')]
for row in rows:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(inputs / row['template']) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(root / 'output' / row['output']) as zout:
        assert zout.testzip() is None
        assert set(zin.namelist()) == set(zout.namelist())
        for name in zin.namelist():
            original, result = zin.read(name), zout.read(name)
            if name.endswith(('.xml', '.rels')):
                tree = ET.fromstring(result)
                alltext = ''.join(tree.itertext()) + ' '.join(v for el in tree.iter() for v in el.attrib.values())
                assert not any(i in alltext for i in identifiers), name
                assert '{{' not in alltext, name
            if name in ('word/document.xml', 'word/header1.xml'):
                old, new = ET.fromstring(original), ET.fromstring(result)
                oldpars = [''.join(p.itertext()) for p in old.iter(W+'p')]
                newpars = [''.join(p.itertext()) for p in new.iter(W+'p')]
                expected = oldpars
                for key, val in dict(title_en=row['title_en'], major=row['major'], author='【匿名评审隐去】', student_id='【匿名评审隐去】').items():
                    expected = [s.replace('{{'+key+'}}', val) for s in expected]
                assert expected == newpars, (name, expected, newpars)
                def structure(el):
                    return (el.tag, el.attrib, None if el.tag == W+'t' else el.text, [structure(c) for c in el])
                assert structure(old) == structure(new), name
            elif name == '[Content_Types].xml':
                old, new = ET.fromstring(original), ET.fromstring(result)
                for el in old:
                    if el.get('PartName') == '/word/document.xml':
                        el.set('ContentType', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml')
                assert ET.tostring(old) == ET.tostring(new)
            else:
                assert original == result, name
        body = ET.fromstring(zout.read('word/document.xml'))
        visible = '\\n'.join(''.join(p.itertext()) for p in body.iter(W+'p'))
        assert 'Candidate: 【匿名评审隐去】' in visible
        assert 'Registration: 【匿名评审隐去】' in visible
        print('VERIFIED:', row['output'], '- fields, anonymity, school content, formatting, media and DOCX type')
assert before == {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in inputs.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
print('VERIFIED: all input files unchanged')
'@ | python -B -"
